plannotator-last.description: Annotate the last assistant message in the local Plannotator UI.
plannotator-last.template: Open local visual annotation for the last assistant message.

plannotator-annotate.description: Annotate a project-relative Markdown, text, or HTML file; folders and URLs are denied.
plannotator-annotate.template: Open local visual annotation for `$ARGUMENTS`. Reject every URL and keep the artifact on this machine.

plannotator-review.description: Review current local changes in Plannotator; remote PR URLs are denied.
plannotator-review.template: Open local visual review for the current worktree using `$ARGUMENTS`. Reject every remote URL.

nexo:resume.description: Resume from the Nexo control plane.
nexo:resume.template: Run `node .opencode/scripts/build-session-context.mjs`. On success, read only AGENTS.md and .opencode/state/session-context.json, then summarize the focused task, constraints, next action, and evidence paths. If generation fails or the packet is insufficient for the decision, use the full resume fallback listed in AGENTS.md.

nexo:bind.description: Bind this session's budget ledger to an explicit task ID.
nexo:bind.template: Confirm the session budget binding requested in `$ARGUMENTS`. Do not perform implementation work.

nexo:doctor.description: Check control-plane continuity and obvious inconsistencies.
nexo:doctor.template: Read AGENTS.md and harness/control/README.md, then verify tasks.md, state/CURRENT.md, state/NEXT.md, latest reports, closeouts, journal, agents, skills, templates, indexes, and OpenCode adapters are internally consistent. Report findings first.

nexo:plan.description: Create a non-mutating implementation plan or handoff, then optionally delegate execution to nexo-build or nexo-infra.
nexo:plan.template: Orchestrate planning through harness/control/agents/nexo-plan.md and the active control workflow. Produce or update a plan and create a handoff when another specialist should execute. Only nexo may delegate, using harness/control/agents/README.md.

nexo:spec.description: Update requirements, stories, acceptance criteria, or traceability.
nexo:spec.template: Use harness/control/agents/nexo-spec.md and harness/control/skills/nexo-requirements-trace.md. Keep NEXO_PROJECT.md as product source and docs/spec/ as the implementable requirements layer.

nexo:design.description: Create UX/UI specs for screens, flows, states, forms, and accessibility.
nexo:design.template: Use harness/control/agents/nexo-design.md and harness/control/skills/nexo-design-spec.md. Produce design specs that can be handed to nexo-build and nexo-qa.

nexo:build.description: Implement code or config from a handoff or diagnosis.
nexo:build.template: Use harness/control/agents/nexo-build.md. For a governed task, run `node harness/control/scripts/control-engine.mjs gate --task TASK-ID --name build` before delegation. Confirm a handoff or investigation exists, implement scoped changes, verify, and update manifest evidence. Run the implemented transition check before changing status to implemented.

nexo:qa.description: Review quality, acceptance, data integrity, and release readiness through the Nexo orchestrator.
nexo:qa.template: For a governed task, first run `node harness/control/scripts/control-engine.mjs gate --task TASK-ID --name qa`. Orchestrate review through harness/control/agents/nexo-qa.md and harness/control/skills/nexo-qa-review.md. Check requirements, acceptance criteria, UX states, tests, data integrity, security handoff, and release readiness. Route corrections from nexo; the QA specialist must not delegate.

nexo:security.description: Review secrets, auth, permissions, privacy, sensitive data, and exposure.
nexo:security.template: For a governed task, first run `node harness/control/scripts/control-engine.mjs gate --task TASK-ID --name security`. Use harness/control/agents/nexo-security.md and harness/control/skills/nexo-security-review.md. Record findings, mitigations, residual risk, and decision.

nexo:infra.description: Execute infrastructure work with strict guardrails.
nexo:infra.template: Use harness/control/agents/nexo-infra.md and harness/control/skills/nexo-infra-guardrails.md. Require ADRs for durable conventions and QA/security review for CI/CD, Kubernetes, deploy, or exposure changes.

nexo:handoff.template: Use harness/control/skills/nexo-handoff.md and harness/control/templates/handoff.md. Include objective, context, source docs, files, steps, verification, risks, acceptance criteria, receiving agent, and required gates.

nexo:close.description: Close a task with evidence and live-state updates.
nexo:close.template: Use harness/control/skills/nexo-close-task.md. For a governed task, update manifest evidence and run `node harness/control/scripts/control-engine.mjs transition --task TASK-ID --to closed`; do not change live status unless it returns ok. Then update README.md, tasks.md, state/CURRENT.md, state/NEXT.md, and append the journal.

fiad:resume.description: Resume from the FIAD canonical ecosystem context.
fiad:resume.template: Read AGENTS.md, harness/control/README.md, harness/control/WORKFLOW.md, harness/control/tasks.md, today's journal, harness/control/state/CURRENT.md, harness/control/state/NEXT.md, harness/control/ecosystem/overview.md, harness/control/ecosystem/integrations.md, harness/control/ecosystem/local-dotnet-service-playbook.md, harness/control/ecosystem/credential-map.md, and the affected Project Profile under harness/control/projects/. Summarize current FIAD task state, project map, risks, and evidence locations.

fiad:doctor.description: Check FIAD control-plane continuity and obvious inconsistencies.
fiad:doctor.template: Read AGENTS.md and harness/control/README.md, then verify FIAD tasks, plans, handoffs, reports, closeouts, journal, ecosystem docs, Project Profiles, state/workspace-map.json, state/project-policy.json, OpenCode adapters, and internal links. Report findings first.

fiad:plan.description: Create a non-mutating FIAD implementation plan or handoff.
fiad:plan.template: Use harness/control/agents/fiad-plan.md and the active control workflow. Read ecosystem docs and affected Project Profiles, then produce or update a FIAD plan and create a handoff when another agent should execute.

fiad:build.description: Implement FIAD code or config from a handoff or diagnosis.
fiad:build.template: Use harness/control/agents/fiad-build.md. Confirm a handoff or investigation exists for non-trivial work, implement scoped changes, verify, and record report, implementation, and closeout as required. Start from ecosystem docs and affected Project Profiles.

fiad:infra.description: Execute FIAD infrastructure work with strict guardrails.
fiad:infra.template: Use harness/control/agents/fiad-infra.md. Read ecosystem docs, workspace-map.json, and affected Project Profiles. Require ADRs for durable conventions and QA/security review for Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, deploy, routing, or exposure changes.

fiad:security.description: Review FIAD secrets, auth, permissions, privacy, sensitive data, and exposure.
fiad:security.template: Use harness/control/agents/fiad-security.md. Read ecosystem/credential-map.md and affected Project Profiles. Record findings, mitigations, residual risk, and decision. Do not write real secrets.

isyte:resume.description: Compatibility alias for fiad:resume. Prefer fiad:resume.
isyte:resume.template: Compatibility alias: use fiad:resume. Read the FIAD canonical ecosystem context under harness/control/ecosystem/ and harness/control/projects/.

isyte:doctor.description: Compatibility alias for fiad:doctor. Prefer fiad:doctor.
isyte:doctor.template: Compatibility alias: use fiad:doctor. Verify FIAD control-plane continuity, Project Profiles, state JSON, adapters, reports, and closeouts.
